answer.thought: The gatekeeper's lantern is lit; the garden is being dismissed from the day. I have six rupees, which will not buy a bottle of wine, nor even a second cup of chai without reducing my reserve to nothing. The body is exhausted, having walked nearly fourteen kilometres, but the spirit is restless with the memory of the file. I shall sit on the wall and watch the shadows lengthen, for the night belongs to the city's interior, not its ornament.
